answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 62 identities means 62 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the cipher pair is tracked in the ember ledger, the jade audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward demands answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 50%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
